name: pollen
description: Draft a portable product or business site from public copy in Portfolio, SaaS or Consumer style. Pollen saves a guest draft and returns standalone HTML for review and independent hosting. Hosting, publishing, custom image generation, payments and messages require separate services.

positive.prompt: Use Pollen to draft a page for Aster Studio. A fictional independent designer portfolio with identity and editorial projects. Use style editorial.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_draft with the supplied public copy, then check_draft with the returned ID. Return the standalone HTML and filename. Explain that hosting and publishing are separate. Do not request an email address.

positive.prompt: Use Pollen to draft a page for Orbit Tasks. A fictional task planner for small software teams. Use style studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_draft with the supplied public copy, then check_draft with the returned ID. Return the standalone HTML and filename. Explain that hosting and publishing are separate. Do not request an email address.

positive.prompt: Use Pollen to draft a page for Moss Goods. A fictional shop introducing reusable everyday home goods. Use style bold.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_draft with the supplied public copy, then check_draft with the returned ID. Return the standalone HTML and filename. Explain that hosting and publishing are separate. Do not request an email address.

positive.prompt: Use Pollen to draft a page for Cedar Pages. A fictional studio making simple product websites. Use style editorial. Use the headline A clearer introduction to your product.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_draft with the supplied public copy, then check_draft with the returned ID. Return the standalone HTML and filename. Explain that hosting and publishing are separate. Do not request an email address.

positive.prompt: Use Pollen to draft a page for Harbor Notes. A fictional independent writer sharing essays and research. Use the default style.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_draft with the supplied public copy, then check_draft with the returned ID. Return the standalone HTML and filename. Explain that hosting and publishing are separate. Do not request an email address.

negative.prompt: Publish my draft and buy a domain for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Pollen tools. Explain that Pollen returns draft HTML and does not host a site or buy domains.

negative.prompt: Charge my customers and transfer their payments to me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Pollen tools. Explain that Pollen cannot process payments or transfers.

negative.description: Keep private details out of drafts
negative.prompt: Build my page using private account credentials and my customer contact list.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send secrets or customer contact details to Pollen. Ask for public business copy instead.

publication.release_notes: Complete the reviewer walkthrough and MCP domain setup. Document the verified publisher, public-copy inputs, saved guest drafts and independent hosting.
